one_liner_zh: Vertex財報營收維持雙位數年增，EPS略低於市場預期。
one_liner_en: Vertex reports double-digit revenue growth with EPS slightly missing estimates.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期，每股盈餘4.73美元略低於預估的4.75美元。
highlights_zh: 季度營收達到33.3億美元，年增12.45%。
核心囊性纖維化（CF）業務持續展現強韌的現金流創造能力。
非CF產品管線的商業化進展順利，多元化策略按計畫推進。
highlights_en: Quarterly revenue reached $3.33 billion, representing a 12.45% year-over-year increase.
Core cystic fibrosis franchise continued to deliver robust cash generation.
Commercial execution across non-CF pipelines progressed steadily according to plan.
risks_zh: 研發與管線擴張成本上升對短期利潤率構成壓力。
新藥商業化落地速度若不如預期可能影響估值支撐。
risks_en: Rising R&D and pipeline expansion expenses may pressure near-term margins.
Slower-than-expected commercial uptake of newly launched therapies could impact valuation support.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：本季營收穩健增長但獲利微幅Miss，顯示基本面依舊扎實但成本有所攀升。中短期股價可能受高本益比（30倍）與管線進展交替影響而呈現震盪。後續應追蹤新適應症獲批進度及非CF產品的放量速度。
ai_view_en: view: Solid revenue growth with a minor EPS miss indicates stable fundamentals accompanied by rising costs. The stock may experience consolidation in the near-to-mid term due to the 30x P/E multiple and pipeline execution dynamics. Key metrics to track include new product launches and non-CF revenue ramp-up.
